findings:
🔵 [K4-overlay-vacuity] CUT/FOLLOW-UP generic non-regression: arm manifest's `fixture-scripts-sg` is overlaid on the row's fixture (`fixture-scripts-w2a/w2b/w1b`) for ALL generic cells (base AND change), so any marker the row's `lib-r2/lib-r4` lib produces that depends on the row's helper format is uniformly suppressed in both arms; the non-regression rule then operates on an empty set (no bias toward SHIP, but no detection either). The spec flags this as a hunt target but does not require mitigation, and the test mocks `f1_session_sha:true` rather than exercising the overlay. Acceptable for this cut; revisit if a generic regression slips past the gate.
🔵 [K4-freeze-ref-label] CUT/FOLLOW-20 freeze-guidance-arm.js `freeze()` passes hardcoded `--ref 'label'` to freeze-pack.js; the real ref/dirty info is written only to `pack_meta[id]` afterwards. The freeze-pack-recorded ref string is therefore meaningless for these arms. Spec is silent on the freeze-pack ref field for carml-built packs; tracking via pack_meta is sufficient for check-guidance-eval.js (which reads arm manifest + pack manifest, not pack_meta). Documented, not blocking.
🔵 [K4-partial-set] CUT/FOLLOW-UP amend-2 session-mode fallback treats ALL set invocations as written when JSON count matches and as `!refused` otherwise (all-or-nothing per Bash call); partial success in one chained call is misattributed. Consistent with the amend-2 contract (call-level fallback) and test s1..s4 cover the chain cases; not exercised in this packet.
